title: Get approval for works to a State heritage item
what: Do work that diminishes a heritage place's significance only under an approval, such as development approval or an approved statement of heritage effect.

sources.title: Heritage Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 74(1) (current republication (R36, from 16 November 2025; Heritage Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) engages in conduct that diminishes the heritage significance of a place or object; and (b) is reckless about whether the conduct would diminish the heritage significance of the place or object

sources.title: Heritage Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 76(2) (current republication (R36, from 16 November 2025; Heritage Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: Section 74 and section 75 do not apply to— (a) engaging in conduct in accordance with any of the following: (i) a heritage guideline; (ii) a heritage direction; (iii) a repair damage direction; (iv) a heritage agreement; (v) a conservation management plan approved by the council; (vi) development approval under the Planning Act 2023, chapter 7; (vii) an excavation permit; (viii) a statement of heritage effect approved by the council;

reach.condition: if it owns or works on an item on the State Heritage Register or under an interim heritage order
